corrections.reason: The printed glyph in አሽከርት is first-order ከ (not sixth-order ክ), matching the standard Amharic plural form አሽከርት.

In the Ge'ez verb ወእፀብኦሙ ('and I will fight against them'), the third radical carries the 3rd-person masculine plural object suffix -ኦሙ, printed clearly with seventh-order ኦ rather than sixth-order እ.
